# Focaccia for a crowd

Stretch and folds during bulk fermentation build strength without heavy kneading. Cold retarding the shaped dough overnight deepens the flavour and makes scoring easier. Focaccia takes generous olive oil in the pan and dimples pressed in just before baking.

## Notes

Bulk fermentation is done when the dough has grown by about half and shows bubbles at the edges. Cold retarding the shaped dough overnight deepens the flavour and makes scoring easier. Salt slows fermentation, so add it after the autolyse rather than at the very start. Focaccia takes generous olive oil in the pan and dimples pressed in just before baking. Shaping creates surface tension so the loaf rises up instead of spreading out. Let bread cool for an hour before slicing; the crumb is still setting as steam escapes.

Cold retarding the shaped dough overnight deepens the flavour and makes scoring easier. Whole wheat flour absorbs more water, so raise hydration when swapping it in. Bulk fermentation is done when the dough has grown by about half and shows bubbles at the edges.

## Steps

- A healthy starter doubles within six hours of feeding at room temperature.
- Focaccia takes generous olive oil in the pan and dimples pressed in just before baking.
- Cold retarding the shaped dough overnight deepens the flavour and makes scoring easier.
- Bulk fermentation is done when the dough has grown by about half and shows bubbles at the edges.
